skills.definition: Develops, implements, and monitors operational strategies aligned with business goals, ensuring efficient production, resource alignment, and timely delivery.
Applies deep technical knowledge to optimize processes, improve efficiency, and reduce downtime through structured improvement methods.
Ensures consistent quality standards, regulatory compliance, and adherence to safety norms across operations.
Optimizes use of manpower, materials, and machines while managing costs and ensuring value-driven operations.
Ability to align operations to incorporate new products and market trends, ensuring speed, flexibility, and quality in NPD.
Builds and sustains high-performing teams by motivating, mentoring, and aligning people to operational goals.
Uses operational data and performance metrics to drive decisions, monitor progress, and enable continuous improvement.
Applies deep technical understanding to operate, monitor, and maintain mechanical production systems and ensure quality, safety, and consistency in output.
Plans, prioritizes, and improves production processes using data, performance metrics, and lean methodologies to ensure consistent output and long-term capability building.
Leads and develops the shop-floor workforce through coaching, communication, and collaboration to achieve production goals and continuous capability development.

The ability to identify, analyze, and resolve recurring mechanical and process defects using structured problem-solving methods to ensure equipment uptime, product consistency, and reduced scrap or rework.
Involves ensuring adherence to safety standards and statutory compliance for equipment, personnel, and processes, while promoting a proactive safety culture across the mechanical section.
Applies strong technical expertise in plating, lacquering, and surface finishing processes to ensure consistent quality, machine efficiency, and safe production outcomes.
Plans, schedules, and monitors electroplating operations for on-time delivery, efficient resource use, and minimal process variation.
Involves checking plating consistency, lacquer finish quality, and defect trends using prescribed parameters to maintain high process reliability.
Involves following prescribed safety norms while handling plating and lacquer chemicals, including storage, usage, disposal, and protective equipment compliance.
Applies technical knowledge of dial assembly processes, printing techniques, and troubleshooting skills to ensure high-quality, error-free output.
Ensures production meets defined standards by enforcing quality protocols, monitoring compliance (e.g., GDD, SHE), and driving productivity improvements.
Supervises, develops, and aligns team members while collaborating with other functions to ensure smooth production flow and workforce efficiency.
The ability to implement, monitor, and enforce safety procedures, hazard controls, and compliance with SHE regulations to ensure safe working conditions on the assembly floor.
Ability to plan, schedule, and optimize production activities across stamping, blanking, plating, and assembly processes to ensure timely delivery, minimal waste, and operational excellence.
Expertise in tools, machines, and materials involved in stamping, blanking, CNC machining, plating, and index assembly – with a strong grasp of quality control and engineering drawings.
Effectively leads shop-floor teams, ensures quality standards, and enforces safety protocols while fostering a high-performance culture of continuous improvement.
Involves implementing and enforcing safety protocols, ensuring compliance with statutory requirements, and maintaining a safe, incident-free working environment in the Index unit.
Ability to develop, maintain, and adjust production plans to meet business goals, capacity constraints, and customer requirements while ensuring smooth workflow and timely delivery.
Ensures timely availability and optimal utilization of raw materials, manpower, and machinery through systematic inventory monitoring, resource allocation, and coordination.
Applies analytical thinking to monitor performance metrics, identify trends, resolve bottlenecks, and generate actionable insights through structured data analysis and reporting.
Applies technical drawing standards and CAD tools (AutoCAD, CorelDraw) to develop accurate, manufacturable product designs aligned with feasibility and customer requirements.
Plans and manages the design team's daily workload and project schedules, ensuring timely delivery of drawings/artworks aligned with production and customer needs.
Collaborates effectively with Sales, Production, and cross-functional teams to ensure accurate translation of customer requirements into manufacturable designs.
Ability to interpret customer requirements and translate them into accurate, manufacturable technical drawings, artworks, and specifications.
Ability to manage end-to-end NPD projects—from feasibility to SOP handover—ensuring quality, cost, and delivery commitments are met.
Ability to define, validate, and optimize manufacturing processes during development to ensure stable, repeatable production.
Ability to engage effectively with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment, approvals, and satisfaction.
Ability to manage NPD documentation, quality validation, and engineering changes to ensure compliance and consistency.

The ability to integrate emerging quality tools, digital systems, and innovation methodologies to future-proof quality processes and enhance predictive capability, traceability, and customer-centric excellence.
Ability to design, implement, monitor, and sustain Quality Management Systems (QMS) in line with regulatory, customer, and organizational requirements.
Ensures that products and processes consistently meet defined quality standards and customer expectations through proactive checks, reviews, root cause analysis, and process improvement initiatives.
Uses structured methodologies to analyze problems, eliminate root causes, and drive sustainable quality and process improvements.
Manages quality interactions with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure trust, transparency, and resolution effectiveness.
Builds quality capability, uses data to guide decisions, and embeds a culture of quality ownership across the organization through communication, influence, and leadership.
Applies deep technical knowledge of tool design, machining, heat treatment, and finishing processes to deliver accurate, reliable, and production-ready tooling.

skills.skill_name: Tool Room Operations, Planning & Cost Control
skills.definition: Plans, executes, and optimizes tool room operations to meet delivery targets, control costs, and ensure high machine and tool availability.
Ensures first-time-right tooling quality while building team capability, cross-functional collaboration, and a culture of discipline and continuous improvement.
Involves enforcing safety practices in tool room operations, ensuring preventive maintenance of machines and tools, and maintaining compliance with standards and 5S protocols.
Ability to conduct preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of machines, utilities, and critical infrastructure.
Ability to identify the root causes of recurring failures and implement sustainable corrective actions to reduce downtime and defects.
Ability to plan maintenance activities, allocate resources, schedule tasks vis-à-vis production, and maintain accurate records.
Depth of domain expertise in machinery, systems (electrical/mechanical), tools, and safety practices required for reliable plant operations.
Ability to manage internal teams, vendors, contractors, and coordinate with cross-functional departments for efficient maintenance delivery.
Manages the preparation, testing, replenishment, and optimization of electroplating baths to ensure consistent quality, reliability, and efficiency in production.
Performs and interprets chemical tests, supports NPD trials, and leads structured problem-solving for process control and continuous improvement.
Ensures adherence to environmental regulations, lab safety protocols, and effective hazardous waste management in line with EHS and PCB guidelines.
The ability to conduct, monitor, and interpret functional, environmental, and lifecycle tests for dials/components to ensure reliability, durability, and customer compliance.
Involves ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and documentation quality of lab test results, supporting compliance to quality norms, audits, and decision-making inputs.
Ability to identify, assess, mitigate, and monitor safety and environmental risks in operations through structured tools and protocols.
Deep understanding and application of EHS legal frameworks, environmental norms, ISO norms, ESG principles and thrid party customer audits to ensure organizational compliance and sustainability.
Ability to develop, implement, and sustain EHS systems, while creating awareness and influencing behavior across all levels of the organization.
Ability to plan, execute, and manage procurement cycles – from identifying requirements to ordering, delivery, and post-order follow-up, aligned with business needs.
Ability to identify, onboard, evaluate, and manage vendors and suppliers, ensuring performance, compliance, and collaborative partnerships.
Ability to ensure procurement adheres to legal, commercial, and compliance standards; negotiate favorable terms to manage risk, cost, and timelines.

Involves maintaining accurate books of accounts, ensuring compliance with statutory requirements (GST, TDS, PF, ESI), and supporting financial reporting and audits through timely and correct documentation.
Involves accurate verification, posting, and reconciliation of vendor bills (domestic & import), ensuring timely payments, resolving discrepancies, and maintaining compliant documentation.

Involves managing day-to-day banking transactions, cash handling, and preparation of export documentation in line with RBI/FEMA guidelines, while maintaining control over accuracy and timely reporting.

Involves preparing, analyzing, and presenting MIS reports, supporting budget preparation and variance tracking, and coordinating audits (internal, statutory, cost, tax, FEMA) with timely and accurate data.

Involves ensuring adherence to financial controls, company SOPs, and statutory guidelines (GST, TDS, FEMA, RBI), while proactively identifying gaps and leading initiatives to improve process reliability and compliance.
Ability to manage, control, and reconcile stock through accurate documentation, perpetual inventory practices, and forecasting techniques to ensure material availability and minimize loss.
Competence in receiving, verifying, issuing materials, and maintaining proper records to ensure smooth operations and compliance with policies and audits.
Ability to use ERP systems (SAP), ensure compliance with statutory/audit requirements, and implement process controls to maintain accuracy, efficiency, and legal adherence in store operations.

Involves timely and accurate generation of domestic and export sales invoices, coordination with production, dispatch, and courier agencies, and ensuring documentation accuracy in line with tax and shipping norms.

The ability to compile, validate, and reconcile sales and purchase data for GST return preparation (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9), ensuring compliance with statutory deadlines, accurate tax reporting, and audit readiness.

Involves preparing accurate export documentation, coordinating with Customs House Agents (CHA), and managing incentive schemes such as EPCG, RODTEP, Duty Drawback, and compliance with DGFT, FEMA, and RBI guidelines.
Ability to manage attendance, salary, wage processing, and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, labour laws, contract workforce) in accordance with legal and organizational standards.
Ability to manage employee lifecycle, industrial harmony, union relations, and overall HR administration, ensuring strong internal governance and external alignment.
Ability to drive HR strategy, talent planning, learning & development, and organizational transformation aligned to business needs.
The ability to manage plant-level administrative functions including housekeeping, canteen, transport, security, and vendor coordination, ensuring operational effectiveness and employee comfort.
The ability to manage employee-related data, ensure accurate records in HR systems, generate meaningful reports, and support audits and decisions through data analysis.
Ability to manage, maintain, and troubleshoot the IT hardware, IT assets, software, servers, and network infrastructure to ensure seamless, secure, and efficient operations.
Ability to secure systems, protect data, manage backups, and ensure compliance with IT policies and cybersecurity standards.
Ability to provide user-centric support, manage digital tools, and execute IT-related projects within defined timelines and scopes.
Ability to carry out, supervise, and analyze visual, dimensional, and functional inspections in line with product specifications, drawings, and customer expectations.
Ability to handle customer returns, perform defect analysis, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and implement corrective/preventive actions.
Ability to manage FEPS quality systems, monitor MIS/reporting, lead reviews, and train/coach the inspection team.
Involves accurate processing of quotations, customer orders, SAP entries, and dispatch documentation, ensuring smooth coordination across internal teams and timely delivery to customers.
The ability to coordinate with customers and internal teams to address queries, follow‑ups, and issues while ensuring continuity of the sales process.
The ability to prepare, maintain, and analyze sales and commercial reports to support tracking, reviews, and management decision‑making.
The ability to plan and implement marketing campaigns, including digital, brand, and promotional initiatives, aligned with business objectives.
The ability to study market trends, customer needs, and competitor activity to identify opportunities for growth and product positioning.

The ability to gather, analyze, and interpret customer, market, and brand insights to influence product positioning, enhance competitive advantage, and support marketing and strategic decision-making.
Ability to plan, track, coordinate and drive the execution of Small Series product batches across departments while meeting timelines and resource constraints.
Ability to interpret technical drawings, understand product and process requirements, and apply structured approaches (e.g., process flows, risk thinking, validations) in small batch production.
Ability to clearly communicate requirements, follow up with internal stakeholders, influence timely action, and escalate critical issues across the value chain.
Ability to understand, apply, and ensure compliance with customs regulations and trade laws while managing all required documentation accurately and efficiently.
Ability to manage timely, clear, and accurate communication between internal teams (logistics, procurement, accounts) and external parties (customs, freight forwarders, CHAs).
Ability to ensure accurate documentation entry, system updates, use of ERP/customs software, and proactive risk mitigation in clearance operations.

successBehaviours.definition: Demonstrates commitment to goals, delivers outcomes reliably, and follows through with accuracy and consistency.
Approaches challenges with structured thinking, identifies root causes, and applies solutions that lead to lasting improvements.
Builds strong relationships, communicates clearly, and works across functions to achieve shared goals and positive outcomes.
Consistently delivers accurate, complete, and high-quality output by focusing on details, standards, and continuous improvement.
Demonstrates curiosity, adapts quickly to change, and develops self and others to stay ahead of evolving business needs.
